 participant App as 💻 Web/Mobile App<br/>(the Client)
 participant Google as 🔐 Google<br/>(accounts.google.com)
 participant API as ☁️ Google APIs<br/>(e.g. Photos, Drive)

 User->>App: 1. Click \"Sign in with Google\"

 Google->>User: 3. Login + \"Allow?\"
 User->>Google: 4. ✅ Yes
 Google-->>App: 5. Redirect with ?code=abc123

 App->>Google: 8. GET /oauth2/v3/userinfo<br/>Bearer access_token
 Google-->>App: 9. 👤 { name, email, picture }
 App->>API: 10. GET /v1/...<br/>Bearer access_token
 API-->>App: 11. 📦 Resource",
